subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Geopolitical Disruptions
description: Learn Geopolitical Disruptions in one minute.

hook.text: Russia invades Ukraine. Overnight, companies must exit Russia, reroute supply chains, and comply with new sanctions.

buildup.text: Geopolitical events create sudden operational disruptions: sanctions, asset freezes, and forced market exits.

discovery.text: Hundreds of companies lost billions abandoning Russian operations. Some left assets they'll never recover.

twist.text: Companies that had Russia-dependent supply chains or revenue streams had no time to build alternatives.

climax.text: Geopolitical risk is operational risk. Country concentration is as dangerous as vendor concentration.

punchline.text: Exit a country overnight. Lose billions. No plan for this.

quiz.question: How did the Russia-Ukraine war create operational risk?
options: Companies faced sudden sanctions, exits, and supply chain disruptions
It had no impact on global business
